$comment: LAT-1022: the latency budget eval's own numbers, one per host-side segment. Every budget is the recon's measured
p50 for that segment plus a margin, and nothing here is a target the product has been tuned to: these are the
values a release may not regress past, not an ambition. The recon is didi-107-1031/RECON-LATENCY.md.
breach: every segment above its budget fails the eval; a segment under its budget prints and passes.

speechEndToCreateMs.basis: recon Q2.A: live_response_latency.msSinceOwnerFinal for a plain turn, n=377 p50 1,006 ms, with margin

createToFirstAudioMs.basis: recon Q2.C: provider create to first PCM, class c p50 3,324 ms end to end with the model leg about 0.5 s

toolOutputToCreateMs.basis: recon Q2.C: live_continuation_timing tool output to response.create, class c n=83 p50 3,324 ms, with margin

providerOutputAckMs.basis: recon Q2.B: trace call.output_written to the next response.created, n=775 p50 489 ms, with margin

connectorRequestMs.basis: recon Q2.E: research_source.ms knowledge n=385 p50 1,528 ms, the slowest connector read with a margin

deadAirRungMs.basis: recon Q2/Q3: the host's own no-output rung, the 8,000 ms dead-air bound the field run breaches in 5.9% of runs
